$comment: Canonical research fill is NEXT_BAR_OPEN. SAME_BAR_CLOSE is BacktestEngine.runStrategyBacktest — do not mix PnL. EXECUTION_MODEL_VERSION stamps every research result.

NEXT_BAR_OPEN.note: Canonical research: signal on closed bar T; fill at bar T+1 open.

SAME_BAR_CLOSE.note: BacktestEngine.run / runStrategyBacktest: evaluate and fill at the same bar close. Optimistic vs live. Not promotion-comparable to NEXT_BAR_OPEN.

THEORETICAL_ZERO_COST.note: Theoretical only. Must not be used as promotion evidence.
